biography.plain_text: Timothy Youngquist is an American businessman who cofounded Youngquist Brothers with his brother Harvey after working in their father's well-drilling business. Based in Fort Myers, they expanded from domestic water wells into large agricultural and municipal projects. Their wider interests included residential development and a substantial limestone quarry in Southwest Florida.

long_biography.plain_text:
Florida drilling entrepreneur Tim Youngquist combined company strategy with the practical design of equipment and support systems. His responsibilities as president included developing project methods and improving the resources available to crews. The business maintained its own machining and fabrication facility, backed by a warehouse of parts and equipment.

This engineering capacity included electric rigs built specifically for deep injection wells. The company developed its own substations and transformer system in consultation with major power suppliers, addressing the rigs' need for electrical power. After constructing five machines, it added two more of substantially the same design.
